hints.title: Yearly Product Aggregate
hints.text: Calculate the total yearly spend for each product by grouping by product_id and transaction year.

hints.title: Lagged Annual Spend
hints.text: Use the lag window function partitioned by product_id and ordered by year to retrieve prev_year_spend.

hints.title: Growth Rate Computation
hints.text: Compute round((curr_year_spend - prev_year_spend) * 100.0 / prev_year_spend, 2) as yoy_rate.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
WITH YearlySpend AS (
    SELECT 
        YEAR(transaction_date) AS year,
        product_id,
        SUM(spend) AS curr_year_spend
    FROM user_transactions
    GROUP BY product_id, YEAR(transaction_date)
)
SELECT 
    year,
    product_id,
    curr_year_spend,
    LAG(curr_year_spend, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY year ASC) AS prev_year_spend,
    ROUND(
        (curr_year_spend - LAG(curr_year_spend, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY year ASC)) * 100.0 
        / LAG(curr_year_spend, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY year ASC),
        2
    ) AS yoy_rate
FROM YearlySpend
ORDER BY product_id ASC, year ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Aggregation and window LAG sorting over years.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Self-joining transactions without grouping by year first creates duplicate product-year rows.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use CTE aggregation and window LAG to compute time-series growth rates.

solutions.approach: CTE Annual Aggregation and Window LAG
solutions.code:
WITH YearlySpend AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM transaction_date)::INT AS year,
        product_id,
        SUM(spend) AS curr_year_spend
    FROM user_transactions
    GROUP BY product_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM transaction_date)
)
SELECT 
    year,
    product_id,
    curr_year_spend,
    LAG(curr_year_spend, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY year ASC) AS prev_year_spend,
    ROUND(
        ((curr_year_spend - LAG(curr_year_spend, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY year ASC)) * 100.0 
        / LAG(curr_year_spend, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY year ASC))::numeric,
        2
    ) AS yoy_rate
FROM YearlySpend
ORDER BY product_id ASC, year ASC;
